tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen. Near-black with a faint green cast.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, the exercise header, the bottom nav, sheets.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Input wells inside a card: weight, reps and RIR fields, set rows.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Pressed state of surface-2 controls, the active set row, selected segments.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Third ground color, a cool slate from Toji's palette, so content cards stand apart from the green-black frame: exercise rows, upcoming set rows, the pinned note, gear toggles. Every text and signal color passes on it (4.7:1 or better). Bars, sheets and the page stay on surface tokens.

tokens.name: card-2
tokens.usage: Raised slate: the active set row, input wells (steppers), and options inside sheets. Every text and signal color passes on it (4.7:1 or better); border-strong 3.4:1.

tokens.name: card-edge
tokens.usage: Decorative hairline around slate cards. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between rows and around cards. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of controls that need to be found: secondary buttons, toggles, empty inputs. At least 3:1 on bg and every surface.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and entered values on bg, every surface and every -soft tint (12:1 or better).

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: JJK names, captions, units, set targets. On bg, every surface and every -soft tint (6.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: text-faded
tokens.usage: Last session's prior values shown faded in empty weight and reps fields. On bg, every surface and every -soft tint (4.9:1 or better). Never for anything the user must act on.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue, muted cursed-energy green: primary buttons, the Done check, active tab, timer ring, links. As text on any surface (5.4:1 or better). The Settings accent picker replaces this token and its three siblings.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of accent buttons; accent text that must stand out on surface-3.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a completed set row and of the active nav item. text, text-2 and accent all read on it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent or accent-strong fill (7.3:1).

tokens.name: preset-plum
tokens.usage: Settings accent preset "Plum" (Toji): replaces accent. Lifted from Toji's #7f5977 so it passes 4.9:1 on surface-3.

tokens.name: preset-plum-strong
tokens.usage: Plum preset: replaces accent-strong.

tokens.name: preset-plum-soft
tokens.usage: Plum preset: replaces accent-soft. text, text-2, text-faded and the plum all pass on it.

tokens.name: preset-blue
tokens.usage: Settings accent preset "Blue" (Six Eyes, Gojo): replaces accent. Gojo's blue at full value, 5.8:1 on surface-3.

tokens.name: preset-blue-strong
tokens.usage: Blue preset: replaces accent-strong.

tokens.name: preset-blue-soft
tokens.usage: Blue preset: replaces accent-soft. text, text-2, text-faded and the blue all pass on it.

tokens.name: cursed
tokens.usage: Second accent, cursed-energy violet: whatever is happening now or is JJK flavor. The active set row and current exercise outline, the rest timer ring, selected RIR, region tags, pinned-note icon, and JJK secondary names. As text on bg, every surface and every -soft tint (5.7:1 or better). Never for primary buttons or Done; those stay accent.

tokens.name: cursed-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of region tags and other cursed-tinted chips. text, text-2 and cursed all pass on it.

tokens.name: on-cursed
tokens.usage: Text on a solid cursed fill such as a selected RIR cell (7.8:1).

tokens.name: preset-plum-cursed
tokens.usage: With the Plum (Toji) preset, replaces cursed: Toji's tan, exact from his palette, so the whole theme is his colors (plum, tan, slate cards). 9.9:1 or better on every surface; twice as light as the plum, so the two never blur.

tokens.name: preset-plum-cursed-soft
tokens.usage: With the Plum preset, replaces cursed-soft (tan-tinted region tags). text, text-2 and text-faded pass on it.

tokens.name: flash
tokens.usage: Black Flash: personal records only. The PR badge, the PR row marker, PR points on charts. As text on bg, surface-1, surface-2 and flash-soft (4.9:1 or better). Always paired with the bolt icon and the word PR.

tokens.name: flash-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a set row that just set a personal record, and of the PR banner.

tokens.name: on-flash
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid flash fill (6.2:1).

tokens.name: stop
tokens.usage: The stop button and stop events only: symptom or injury, end this exercise. Amber, not red, so it never reads as a personal record. As text on any surface (7.2:1 or better). Always paired with the octagon icon and the word Stop.

tokens.name: stop-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the stop sheet and of stop-event rows in history and on the calendar.

tokens.name: on-stop
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid stop fill (9.8:1).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Swapped status and neutral notices. As text on any surface (6.4:1 or better). Always paired with the swap icon.

tokens.name: recover
tokens.usage: Recovery and cardio only (Reverse Cursed Technique): Sunday recovery, Saturday cardio, cardio minutes against the weekly target, recovery-day calendar cells. As text on every surface and card (6.4:1 or better). Close to accent in hue and lightness, so never place it beside a green Done mark; pair it with the heart-pulse icon and a word.

tokens.name: recover-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of recovery and cardio day cards and calendar cells. text, text-2 and text-faded pass on it.

tokens.name: on-recover
tokens.usage: Text on a solid recover fill (8.7:1).

tokens.name: grade
tokens.usage: Grades and goals only (Grade 4 → Special Grade): grade badges, dashed goal and target lines on progress charts, weekly targets. Pale Jujutsu gold, 9.5:1 or better on every surface and card. Warm like stop, so it appears only on progress and library screens, never on a screen with a Stop button.

tokens.name: grade-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of grade badges. text, text-2 and grade pass on it.

tokens.name: on-grade
tokens.usage: Text on a solid grade fill (12.5:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard and switch focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Light ink so it shows against accent, flash and stop fills alike.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the screen behind a bottom sheet such as the stop sheet or Swap list.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Exercise name at the top of the set-logging screen; screen titles.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Weight, reps and seconds inside input fields, entered or faded. Tabular figures.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above values and columns: SET, LBS, REPS, RIR.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Keep elbows under the bar; stop at a pinch.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Smallest text in the app. Never smaller than this.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Minimum gap between two tap targets; icon to label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between set rows; padding inside input wells.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap above the action bar; around the rest timer.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top padding of full-screen sheets.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest hit area for anything tappable, in both directions. Icon buttons included.

tokens.name: tap-row
tokens.usage: Height of set rows, fields and the primary in-workout buttons, for sweaty thumbs.

tokens.name: tap-hero
tokens.usage: Height of the bottom action bar's main button (Log set).

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icon glyph size inside a 44px target.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, the PR badge, segment cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, set rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and the top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toggles and the rest-timer pill.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the sticky action bar only. Everything else separates by surface step and border.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Press feedback, checkbox fill, segment select.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Row state changes (to done, to PR), chip and toggle moves.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Sheets sliding up, the PR banner entering. Nothing runs longer.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Things entering or settling: sheets, banners, row fills.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Things moving in place: toggles, the timer ring.
